label: Upstream 0.100.1, with a terminal in the chat

sections.title: From upstream 0.100.0 to 0.100.1
items: There's a terminal right inside the chat. Start your message with `!`, like `!git status`, and it runs in your project with live output, a `Stop` button and the exit code, while errors show up in their own colour. A picker lists the commands you've run and the ones that fit your project, GG sees the output with your next message, and nothing runs without your OK unless you pick `Always allow in this project`. API keys in your environment never show in the output; they read `[REDACTED]` instead.

Images in replies actually show up now. When GG points at a screenshot or picture on your computer, you see the real image right in the chat instead of a broken icon, and one click opens it full size.

sections.title: Also in your Local Fork
items: Commands work in every pane. Each `!` command runs in that pane's own project and its output stays in that pane, so a split window never mixes up two projects. Images with Windows paths like `E:/shots/home.png` show up too, and open from the pane that showed them.
The chat holds still. When the message box, the tool feed or your queued messages change size, the conversation now glides into its new spot instead of jumping a frame later.
